name: When should I consider a price adjustment for my luxury home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a price adjustment for my luxury home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a price adjustment for your luxury home if it has been on the market for an extended period without significant interest, offers, or showings. Typically, after 30-60 days with minimal activity, it's advisable to re-evaluate. Market feedback, new comparable listings, or changes in economic conditions can also warrant a review. We closely monitor buyer activity and market dynamics in areas like Highland Beach or Boca Raton to recommend strategic price adjustments. Delaying a necessary price correction can lead to a perception of the property being stale and result in a lower final sale price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider a price adjustment if your luxury home lacks interest or offers after 30-60 days, or if market conditions change. Timely adjustments prevent staleness.
